content:
Buying a home is likely the biggest financial decision of your life. Using a mortgage rates calculator helps you understand exactly what you'll pay each month.

## How Mortgage Calculators Work

Our mortgage calculator takes into account:
- Principal loan amount
- Interest rate (annual percentage)
- Loan term (15, 20, or 30 years)
- Property taxes and insurance (optional)

## Current Mortgage Rates

As of 2024, mortgage rates hover around 6-7% for 30-year fixed loans. Use our calculator to see how different rates affect your payment.

## Why Calculate Before Buying

Knowing your monthly payment helps you:
1. Determine how much home you can afford
2. Compare lender offers fairly
3. Plan your budget effectively
4. Understand total interest costs
